Stock market news | SEBI Proposes Scrapping Additional Disclosures for Foreign Investors

On 20 November 2026, SEBI proposed scrapping the additional disclosure framework for foreign portfolio investors. The proposal aims to end mandatory look-through disclosures for large and concentrated foreign funds, easing compliance requirements for overseas investors.
